name: UConn School of Business
note: UConn shuttered its traditional two-year full-time MBA in 2021 after enrollment fell from 110 students in 2016 to 76 in 2021, redirecting resources into a part-time Flex MBA (Hartford, Stamford, and online) and a 100 percent Online MBA (Poets and Quants, Nov 2024: https://poetsandquants.com/2024/11/02/anatomy-of-an-mba-makeover-uconns-flex-omba-programs/). U.S. News 2026 ranks UConn only in Part-time MBA (No. 35 tie).
notes: UConn shuttered its traditional two-year full-time on-campus MBA in 2021 (Poets and Quants, November 2024, quoting UConn academic co-directors) and redirected resources into a 100% Online MBA launched fall 2021 and a part-time hybrid Flex MBA (both 42 credits). The school's official MBA programs page today lists only Online MBA, Flex MBA, and a fast-track One-Year MBA; no two-year full-time on-campus program is offered. Stopped admitting to the two-year full-time format around 2021. Sources: https://mba.business.uconn.edu/mba-programs/ ; https://poetsandquants.com/2024/11/02/anatomy-of-an-mba-makeover-uconns-flex-omba-programs/ ; https://www.business.uconn.edu/2022/01/20/mba-your-way/
